apps/web/src/features/evry/review/Review.reason: The review card's approval countdown is the product behavior: when the time the server said was left runs out, the card turns Expired and Approve goes away (R5-5). The browser's clock is never read, so a clock set hours ahead or behind changes nothing; nothing else announces the moment the approval ends. It runs only while the card is on screen and is cleared when the review changes or the card leaves.

Temporary survivor until T-414 removes it, waiting for a server push (QF-C-14): an approved change runs in a background job and the card reads its review again on a backoff until the outcome is saved. The server has no channel that says the job ended, so only a read can learn it. It runs only while a card on screen shows a running change with no action in flight, and stops at the outcome, an action, a refusal or when the card leaves. It goes away once the conversation stream or a review stream publishes the outcome.
